description: Book digitized by Google from the library of the University of Michigan and uploaded to the Internet Archive by user tpb.

Each part in the original illustrated blue paper covers (essays I-V, VII-VIII/IX, X pt. 2) or blue paper boards (essays VI, X pt. 1), as issued. Title page for v. 1 (dated 1797) in essay V, for v. 2 (dated 1798) in essay VIII/IX. Essay VII and essay X in 2 pts.; essays VIII-IX in 1 pt. Vol. 3 without t.p. (issued with a later part)

Vol. 3, completed in 1802, contained also essay X, pt. III and essays XI-XV; a 4th vol., containing essays XVI-XVIII, was issued in 1812. Cf. ESTC T109571; cf. also The complete works of Count Rumford / published by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences. 1870-1875. Vol. 4, p. 815-816

Title page to v. 2 lacks edition statement. Edition statements on covers of parts vary: Essays I, V: "The third edition"; essays II-III: "The second edition"; other parts lack statement. For original edition of essays I-II, 1795-1796, cf. ESTC N27953, N16611
"Printed by A. Strahan"--Page [1] of covers of essay X, pt. I. "Luke Hansard, printer"--Page [4] of covers of essay X, pt. II
Signatures: Vol. 1: a² B-H⁸ b² I-M⁸ N⁶ c² O-U⁸ d1 X-2C⁸ 2D1 pi⁴ e² 2E-2H⁸ 2I⁶; v. 2: a² B-N⁸ O² b² *P² P-X⁸ Y² (Y2 blank) c² Z-2C⁸ 2D⁶ pi² 2E-2L⁸; v. 3: a⁴ B-N⁸ O² (G8 blank)

Illustrations: 19 prints : engraving ; full-page (18), double-page (1). By S.J. Neele (12) and T. Lowry (7); 2 after F. Thurn and T. Webster, respectively. -- 12 prints : wood engraving ; full-page. -- Engraved headpiece to essay I; numerous wood engraved ill. in the text

Essay I: An account of an establishment for the poor at Munich ... 1797 -- Essay II: Of the fundamental principles on which general establishments for the relief of the poor may be formed in all countries. 1796 -- Essay III: Of food; and particularly of feeding the poor. 1796 -- Essay IV: Of chimney fire-places ... 1796 -- Essay V.A short account of several public institutions lately formed in Bavaria; together with the appendix to the first volume. 1797 -- Essay VI: Of the management of fire, and the economy of fuel. 1797 -- Essay VII: Of the manner in which heat is propagated in fluids ... 1797 -- Essay VII: Of the propagation of heat in fluids. Part II: An account of several new experiments ... 1798 -- Essay VIII: Of the propagation of heat in various substances ... -- Essay IX: An experimental inquiry concerning the source of the heat which is excited by friction. 1798 -- Essay X: On the construction of kitchen fire-places and kitchen utensils, together with remarks and observations relating to the various processes of cookery; and proposals for improving that most useful art. Part I, 1799[-part II, 1802]
